description: Finance Matrix is a highly configurable matrix visual for Power BI, ideal for financial statements such as income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports, and equally useful for any structured, hierarchical report that needs full control over layout and calculations. It's built for accountants, financial analysts, business analysts, report developers, controllers, and anyone creating structured Power BI reports who wants their tables to look exactly the way their organization already presents its numbers. Features include custom rows and subtotals, rule-based conditional formatting, multi-level column hierarchies (e.g. Year over Quarter), per-column measure bindings, and image/icon rendering directly inside cells.
